home_heading: Apply for your recommendation letter from home
home_body: Apply, upload your documents, and download the approved letter.
design_intro: Three colours: maroon, teal and mustard, on cream.
design_modal_body: Once approved, the recommendation letter can be issued.
tab_rejected_body: No applications were rejected this week.
login_intro: We’ll send a one-time code to your mobile.
login_code_sent: Code sent to {phone}. Use it within 5 minutes.
login_code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Try again.
login_deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your ward office.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
profile_intro: This name goes on your letters. Write your full name as on your citizenship.
apply_intro: Choose your address and the kind of letter, fill in the details. You can add documents and submit afterwards.
service_none_here: This municipality doesn’t offer online letters yet.
field_invalid: This doesn’t look right; please check it.
apply_draft_note: After saving the draft you can upload documents and submit.
detail_ready_to_submit: Everything is ready. You can submit.
detail_waiting_note: Your application is with the ward office. Its status will update here.
detail_needs_info_note: The ward office asked for more information. Read the note below, fix it and submit again.
detail_rejected_note: This application was rejected. See the reason below.
detail_approved_note: Approved. The letter is waiting to be issued.
detail_issued_note: Your recommendation letter has been issued.
detail_conflict: This application was changed elsewhere. We loaded the latest version; please try again.
documents_hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB
documents_too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
documents_wrong_type: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files.
letter_verify_note: Anyone can check this letter by scanning its QR code.
admin_intro: Assign ward secretaries and chairs for {municipality}. Nobody is deleted: deactivated staff keep their name on the letters they handled.
staff_assign_intro: They log in with this mobile number using a one-time code. A citizen account with the same number becomes a staff account.
staff_edit_intro: Move them to another ward or switch between secretary and chair.
staff_deactivate_body: They lose access immediately, even if they are logged in. Letters they handled keep their name.
staff_reactivate_body: They can log in again with the same mobile number.
staff_error_ward_has_chair: Ward {ward} already has an active chair. Deactivate or move them first.
staff_error_phone_is_staff: This number already belongs to staff or an admin.
queue_intro: Applications for your ward, oldest first.
review_no_action: Nothing for you to do on this application right now.
review_conflict: Someone else acted on this application first. We loaded the latest version.
review_start_body: Check the details and documents. If everything is in order, the ward chair approves it.
review_approve_body: You approve it as ward chair. The letter can then be issued.
review_issue_body: This takes the next number from the ward's register and dates it today. It cannot be undone.
review_needs_info_title: Ask the citizen for more information?
review_needs_info_body: They can edit and resubmit. Say exactly what is missing.
review_reject_body: The application is closed. The citizen sees your reason.
mine_intro: Every letter you have asked for, newest first.
mine_empty: You haven't applied for anything yet.
mine_empty_hint: Choose your address and the kind of letter you need. You can save a draft and finish later.
